messages:
maria: FYI opened PR with migration guide + SDK snippet updates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7901. Targets release cutoff and needs merge timing coordination.
kevin: Thanks — assigning myself to review. Quick question: snippet uses beta client flag. Is that behind a feature flag rollout?
maria: Yes, beta is gated by feature flag 'model-serving-v2'. We should not expose live snippet until the FF is flipped. Plan: add a banner and hold the merge until the cutoff window opens.
ashley: CI preview kicked off; docs-ci-bot will post the link when ready.
docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed for PR #7901 1https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-7901 (status: failed). Build error: import path changed in SDK v0.13. See logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/logs/7901
kevin: I'll push a tiny import fix to align with SDK v0.13. Also adding a versioned TOC entry under /docs/v2/ to avoid confusion.
maria: Good call. Also add a short "applies only after FF is enabled" callout. Use the standard yellow callout template.
tonY: I'll do a quick editorial pass once preview passes. Can we schedule the merge after the release cutoff on 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC? Prefer a small buffer after FF flip.
maria: Proposed schedule: add label 'hold-until-ff', merge earliest at 09:10 UTC once docs-ci-bot preview is passing and FF state is confirmed.
ashley: Preview re-run in progress.
docs-ci-bot: Re-deploying preview for PR #7901 1https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-7901 (status: pending).
kevin: Fix pushed (branch: 7901-path-fix). Also included a migration checklist and a short snippet that demonstrates the old->new API mapping.
maria: Nice. Also make sure the migration checklist includes the config flag names for customers on Dedicated/Private.
kevin: Done. Added note: "Dedicated/Private: ensure runtime config includes feature_flag: model-serving-v2 or upgrade runtime package".
tonY: Preview is now passing. Spotted one small grammar nit in the checklist, will update inline.
docs-ci-bot: Preview status: passing. Link: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-7901 (deployed at 2026-03-30T23:42:01Z)
maria: Applying 'hold-until-ff' label now. Reminder: do not merge before 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC when FF opens in production.
kevin: Resolving nit and marking ready for approve.
tonY: approved
maria: On FF flip at 09:00 UTC we'll verify FF state (I'll check dashboard), then merge at ~09:10 UTC if all green. I'll post here when merged.
docs-ci-bot: Feature flag check: model-serving-v2 state reported as OFF in production at 2026-04-01T08:58:45Z.
maria: FF still OFF 1 waiting.
kevin: pinging infra to confirm rollout schedule.
maria: FF reported ON at 2026-04-01T09:02:08Z.
kevin: Merging now.
docs-ci-bot: PR #7901 merged at 2026-04-01T09:11:05Z. Live site build started.
maria: Confirmed live site serving updated v2 docs at 09:23 UTC. Closing thread.
